definitions.explanation: A political party, usually one already named in the context ("the party"). As a suffix it forms party names: {自民党|じみんとう}, {共産党|きょうさんとう}, {新党|しんとう}. Also used humorously of a group sharing a taste: {甘党|あまとう} (people with a sweet tooth).

examples.japanese: {党|とう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{方針|ほうしん}→方針：04871_houshin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{従|したが}う→従う：02059_shitagau⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{党|とう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{離|はな}れて→離れる：02397_hanareru⟧⟦{無所属|むしょぞく}→無所属：13583_mushozoku⟧になった。
examples.english: He left the party and became an independent.

examples.japanese: ⟦{選挙|せんきょ}→選挙：03303_senkyo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、{各党|かくとう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{代表|だいひょう}→代表：03419_daihyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦テレビ→テレビ：01536_terebi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{討論|とうろん}した→討論する：25379_touronsuru⟧。
examples.english: Before the election, the leaders of each party debated on television.

notes:
On its own {党|とう} usually means a party already mentioned; to say "a political party" in general, use ⟦{政党|せいとう}→政党：04338_seitou⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {党|とう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{方針|ほうしん}→方針：04871_houshin⟧: party policy, the party line
- {党|とう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{離|はな}れる→離れる：02397_hanareru⟧ / {離党|りとう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to leave the party
- {各党|かくとう}: each party
- ⟦{党首|とうしゅ}→党首：17742_toushu⟧: party leader

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{政党|せいとう}→政党：04338_seitou⟧: political party; the general word
- ⟦{与党|よとう}→与党：05241_yotou⟧ / ⟦{野党|やとう}→野党：02438_yatou⟧: the ruling party / the opposition
